虛偽世界的開端與角色的覺醒

說故事的人井川一指出，電影開頭以一名遭霸凌的無名少女為起點，少女在絕望之際撥通了象徵曉美焰的電話並許願成為魔法少女。然而這場戰鬥僅是焰將自己不用的裝備借給路人宣洩情緒，避免其魔女化或驚動圓環之理。井川一認為，電影耗費開頭寶貴時間描繪無關主線的角色，成為劇本結構的一大警訊。在焰所編織的虛假世界中，鹿目圓過著平凡生活，巴麻美與佐倉杏子對異狀毫無所覺，唯有繼承了魔女之力的美樹爽，以及暗中保留記憶並享受偽世生活的百江渚察覺了真相。

三大神秘入侵者與圓環之理的異變

這座世界的平靜隨後被三名神秘入侵者打破，她們分別是戴眼鏡的法學生樹里、雙馬尾少女蕾瑪，以及外表如同異色曉美焰的魔女之夜化身。井川一揭示，魔女之夜作為眾多魔女的集合體，因對鹿目圓無與倫比的執念而化作愛意最強烈的焰之姿態。這三名入侵者原為被圓環之理拯救的魔女，但因曉美焰奪走鹿目圓的人格，導致圓環之理淪為毫無感情的機械菩薩，促使她們企圖奪回圓的自我意識；其中名為塞爾瑪的角色更被揭發為認同丘比理念的狂熱信徒，企圖重啟魔女化機制來為宇宙補充能源。

摘要

虛偽世界的開端與角色的覺醒

說故事的人井川一指出，電影開頭以一名遭霸凌的無名少女為起點，少女在絕望之際撥通了象徵曉美焰的電話並許願成為魔法少女。然而這場戰鬥僅是焰將自己不用的裝備借給路人宣洩情緒，避免其魔女化或驚動圓環之理。井川一認為，電影耗費開頭寶貴時間描繪無關主線的角色，成為劇本結構的一大警訊。在焰所編織的虛假世界中，鹿目圓過著平凡生活，巴麻美與佐倉杏子對異狀毫無所覺，唯有繼承了魔女之力的美樹爽，以及暗中保留記憶並享受偽世生活的百江渚察覺了真相。

三大神秘入侵者與圓環之理的異變

這座世界的平靜隨後被三名神秘入侵者打破，她們分別是戴眼鏡的法學生樹里、雙馬尾少女蕾瑪，以及外表如同異色曉美焰的魔女之夜化身。井川一揭示，魔女之夜作為眾多魔女的集合體，因對鹿目圓無與倫比的執念而化作愛意最強烈的焰之姿態。這三名入侵者原為被圓環之理拯救的魔女，但因曉美焰奪走鹿目圓的人格，導致圓環之理淪為毫無感情的機械菩薩，促使她們企圖奪回圓的自我意識；其中名為塞爾瑪的角色更被揭發為認同丘比理念的狂熱信徒，企圖重啟魔女化機制來為宇宙補充能源。

始源之種的真相與劇本整體評價

針對魔女概念未隨圓環之理徹底消失的疑問，井川一解釋這三名敵人源自獨立於時空之外的始源之種（根之國），此處封存著所有成為魔女之人的名冊與歷史。故事更進一步揭曉最初魔女Marguerite的過往，說明她曾是擁有淨化詛咒能力的善良少女，卻因力量極限而走向悲劇。井川一總結，本片耗費大半篇幅於主角群與新敵人的交戰，但實質推動劇情的僅有曉美焰與美樹爽，其餘角色多半淪為背景，整體風格更偏向非正統續作的番外篇，但其對魔女起源設定的完整交代仍具有相當的觀賞價值。

  • 揭露全新世界觀與反派秘密：詳細剖析三位新入侵者真實身分、異色曉美焰的本質，以及超越時空的「始源之種」與最初魔女設定。
  • 客觀剖析劇本優勢與結構隱憂：從角色戲份失衡、節奏掌控到新熱門組合「焰爽」的崛起，提供全面且犀利的觀影解讀。

摘要

虛偽世界的開端與角色的覺醒

說故事的人井川一指出，電影開頭以一名遭霸凌的無名少女為起點，少女在絕望之際撥通了象徵曉美焰的電話並許願成為魔法少女。然而這場戰鬥僅是焰將自己不用的裝備借給路人宣洩情緒，避免其魔女化或驚動圓環之理。井川一認為，電影耗費開頭寶貴時間描繪無關主線的角色，成為劇本結構的一大警訊。在焰所編織的虛假世界中，鹿目圓過著平凡生活，巴麻美與佐倉杏子對異狀毫無所覺，唯有繼承了魔女之力的美樹爽，以及暗中保留記憶並享受偽世生活的百江渚察覺了真相。

三大神秘入侵者與圓環之理的異變

這座世界的平靜隨後被三名神秘入侵者打破，她們分別是戴眼鏡的法學生樹里、雙馬尾少女蕾瑪，以及外表如同異色曉美焰的魔女之夜化身。井川一揭示，魔女之夜作為眾多魔女的集合體，因對鹿目圓無與倫比的執念而化作愛意最強烈的焰之姿態。這三名入侵者原為被圓環之理拯救的魔女，但因曉美焰奪走鹿目圓的人格，導致圓環之理淪為毫無感情的機械菩薩，促使她們企圖奪回圓的自我意識；其中名為塞爾瑪的角色更被揭發為認同丘比理念的狂熱信徒，企圖重啟魔女化機制來為宇宙補充能源。

始源之種的真相與劇本整體評價

針對魔女概念未隨圓環之理徹底消失的疑問，井川一解釋這三名敵人源自獨立於時空之外的始源之種（根之國），此處封存著所有成為魔女之人的名冊與歷史。故事更進一步揭曉最初魔女Marguerite的過往，說明她曾是擁有淨化詛咒能力的善良少女，卻因力量極限而走向悲劇。井川一總結，本片耗費大半篇幅於主角群與新敵人的交戰，但實質推動劇情的僅有曉美焰與美樹爽，其餘角色多半淪為背景，整體風格更偏向非正統續作的番外篇，但其對魔女起源設定的完整交代仍具有相當的觀賞價值。

Because Walpurgisnacht exists. independently of time and space, it can. perceive time; to it, the first. timeline and the Nth timeline are the. same. After all, Madoka Kaname would. eventually become the person it was. looking for—so, that's okay. Now. let's talk about the ending that left. most people confused. I'll describe it. in the most plain language possible:. Ultimate Madoka appeared at the. threshold of the universe. Homura saw. how terrifying it was to see Madoka. without her humanity and finally. regretted her actions. This "Devil" really is a bundle of contradictions,. deciding to just give Madoka back, but. then Sayaka jumped in and gave her a. pep talk, saying, "You of all people. shouldn't call her Ultimate Madoka. Aren't you the Devil?" Be more selfish! "The positions suddenly flipped,. turning from rivals into supporters. As. for this sudden shift in sides, you. could argue that there were indeed. clues leading up to it. Before the. final battle broke out, wasn't there a. part where Sayaka was completely. exhausted, saying" What are we even. doing now? Forget it, I'm going home, " and she actually just walked off to go. to sleep. Oh, it was hilarious. This is. my favorite part of the entire film,. because by that point, the plot was so. chaotic that my state of mind was. perfectly synchronized with Sayaka's. But then, Madoka walked in and gave. Sayaka another pep talk, basically. saying to stop overthinking things,. that justice and responsibility don't. matter, and that living a free and. happy life is what's truly best. This. was the moment that woke Sayaka up. She. had always been thinking about the. bigger picture, but now she decided to. act for the sake of Madoka's personal. happiness as well. I think this is a. more reasonable interpretation. In any. case, Homura, in order to protect. Madoka and defy fate, merged Madoka's. Soul Gem with her own Devil Gem,. creating a new" super-evolved "form.

With a gem in each eye, she rose up to. fight Ultimate Madoka, and then she was. instantly defeated. Yes, it was super. abrupt. When she came to, Madoka was. right there beside her. And here,. Madoka repeated that classic line. Homura once asked her:" Do you think. your life is precious? "Do you cherish. your family and friends?" If this world. is far from what someone imagined it to. be, would you be willing to forgive me?

"The sentence structure is almost. identical, but the content is slightly. different. The meaning of this part is. very vague; we can only deduce it based. on the implications from when it. appeared previously. The two previous. times Homura asked Madoka these. questions, she was hoping that she. would stay away from the world of. magical girls and just be an ordinary. person. So, my guess is that this part. is essentially about taking back the. divine power while also wiping away the. memories of her, and then leaving this. universe to return to being a distant. god. This point can be seen quite. clearly from the deluxe movie pamphlet. included with the Japanese release. Here, Madoka and Homura are carrying. the burden together, but when the page. turns, both Madoka and the concept of. the devil are gone, which means that by. the end, both of these things have. vanished from this world; essentially,. this is the ending of the first season. In this iteration, no one remembers who. Madoka is, and this segment, along with. the opening sequence featuring that. bystander, achieves a sort of narrative. symmetry. Originally, Homura used her. power to give that random girl a. beautiful dream, and at the end, when. she wakes up, it should feel like she. just had a long dream. In the clip, how. do we see the life hotline being moved. to a different location? With them. meeting again, a large hand reaches in. —likely the hand of the Law of Cycles. —implying that from now on, Madoka. will be responsible for listening to. the wishes of magical girls. But the. key point is that Kyubey is here too,. strongly suggesting that they have. grasped the secret to creating witches.

If there is to be another movie, then. it will almost certainly involve a. decisive, life-or-death battle against. the Kyubey species. Do you know why I. don't like this decision? Because this. is the kind of retcon that makes the. characters 'previous actions look. incredibly stupid. This turns the. ending of the first season into one. where Homura needlessly explained the. concept of witches to Kyubey, leading. Kyubey to try and create them, with one. slip of the tongue rendering all of. Madoka's sacrifices completely in vain. In" Rebellion, "this issue was still. acceptable because, in the end, Homura. turned the tables and took control of. Kyubey, making it feel safe; but now,. everything is futile again, even with. the" Walpurgisnacht Rising "ending. To. put it super, super simply: Homura's. plan to save Madoka failed, Madoka. ultimately chose to sacrifice herself. to go back to work, and Kyubey's. conspiracy will continue. The theme of. the story could be said to be the. burden of salvation; Homura hopes to. save Madoka, Kyubey wants to save the. universe, and Madoka herself was born. out of the hope to save all magical. girls. Many people have a" savior. complex, "wanting to change the world. single-handedly, but in contrast, the. personal freedom and individual. happiness represented by Madoka are. perhaps what the girls truly need in. the end; it's just that at this stage,. they are still a distance away from. that destination. The themes are. profound, and the visuals are truly. impeccable. There are plenty of. interesting symbols in the film, and. take Sayaka, for instance—her. character is a highlight. Would I call. it a zero-score work? Of course not,. but I believe its problems far outweigh. its merits. I’ve mentioned this quite. a few times: I have a bit of a fixation. on consistent world-building. I. physically cannot stand an abundance of. those cryptic, nonsensical" riddle-master "lines. To me, you can't. just use the term" stream of. consciousness "as a shield for every. baffling plot development, you know? There’s good stream of consciousness. and bad stream of consciousness. The. plot holes are actually endless; for. example, does the Law of Cycles affect. the past, present, and future. simultaneously? If time doesn't exist. in a linear sequence, then Homura. erasing Madoka's identity means the Law. of Cycles should logically have never. had an identity to begin with. So, how. could the trio of witches possibly know. that a Homura had snatched away their. savior? Why can the trio of witches. revert to human form just by passing.

through the barrier? Is it really that. convenient? Are we just supposed to. walk through whenever we want? Besides,. once you become a magical girl, don't. you only have a Soul Gem left? Your. physical body remains in the real world. , but these three should have turned to. dust ages ago. Sayaka even had a. funeral back then. What is the logic. behind them growing from a mass of. spirits back into a complete physical. body? Furthermore, once you become a. witch, you’re supposed to be left. with a Grief Seed. How did they get. their Soul Gems back and transform just. like that? Also, why can Homura use. Madoka’s Soul Gem? Why didn’t. Madoka’s body immediately shut down. when her Soul Gem left her? Why does. Madoka still have a Soul Gem at all? Didn't she turn into a witch and then. get blown away by herself? Madoka’s. witch form even appears in this episode. . Let me tell you, I’m certain—I. trust there must be fans out there even. more capable and devoted to this IP. than I am who could explain every. single one of these questions. But. that’s exactly where the problem lies. . These strange contradictions. shouldn't exist in the first place. The. first season was already a perfect,. closed loop; it's these later parts. that openly violate the established. rules, creating so many holes that fans. have to band together to plug. Walpurgisnacht Rising's issue isn't. that it's too bold, but that its pacing. is poorly distributed. It spends the. first half focusing on the witches,. then abruptly shifts back to the. original characters. As a result,. Madoka's final sacrifice is barely. recognized as such by many, since she. spends the first ninety minutes in a. state of confusion and ignorance. The. script feels pieced together from. leftover ideas, and with the multiple. revisions and delays during production,. it ultimately lost focus on what it was. even trying to express—that is its. biggest problem. I want to emphasize. that I'm not some stubborn purist who. insists a series can never have a. sequel. As long as there's a good idea,. I believe any story can continue. The. Toy Story films are perfect examples. because the creators were willing to. let the characters grow and undergo. meaningful change. Unfortunately,. Madoka is not like that. Madoka, Mami,. Sayaka, and even Kyubey haven't. undergone any significant changes; only. their costumes keep changing. I can. almost hear the executives standing by. the character designers’ desks,. shouting," Make the outfits more. elaborate so we can produce more. figures and merchandise to make money!

"They aren't trapped in a cycle of fate. ; they are trapped in a cycle of. capitalism. They are forced to reset to. their default states to keep the IP. alive, until everything that happened. in the first season slowly loses its. meaning. Finally, I want to say that I. know it might be hard for you to feel. this through the screen, but every time. I make a video that's more critical, I. do it with 100%genuine responsibility.

If I truly hated it or couldn't stand. it, I’d just post some trashy tweets,. mock it, and call it a day. Why go. through all this trouble? Well, it's. because I love Puella Magi Madoka. Magica. I care about where these. characters are headed. That is why I. wanted to sort through all my thoughts. on the film as thoroughly as possible.

Alright, that's it for this video.

I’m Jing-Yi. Since I haven't seen it. for very long, I've tried my best to be. accurate, but there are likely still. mistakes. Please feel free to help me. out in the comments below.

世界線的前提設定

在說故事的人今川義所闡述的這條IF平行世界線中，命運存在著兩個重大前提：首先是魯迪烏斯．格雷拉特從未真正降生，其原本的嬰兒肉體因承受不住過量的拉普拉斯因子而成為死胎；其次是震驚大陸的轉移事件完全沒有發生，這也意味著居心叵測的人神在此歷史中不曾登場干涉眾人命運。

格雷拉特家族的平靜生活與諾倫的宿命

痛失長子的塞妮絲與保羅經歷漫長悲痛後，於數年後順利迎來諾倫與愛夏的降生。由於免去了轉移異變，保羅未因迎戰九頭龍身亡，塞妮絲也未曾被封印於迷宮水晶中。即便女僕莉莉雅與保羅的私通依舊發生，心懷喪子內疚的塞妮絲仍選擇包容接納，三人於布耶納村和睦生活。長大後的諾倫在阿斯拉王國就學，隨後成為兼具戰鬥與演奏的吟遊詩人；在冒險中她被瑞傑路德從魔物手中救下，兩人相戀成婚並育有名為莉莉的女兒。

洛琪希與希露菲的迷宮探索羈絆

水聖級魔法師洛琪希依然受聘前來擔任家庭教師，但她所發掘的魔法神童變成了愛夏。在村中生活期間，洛琪希偶然挺身解救了遭受霸凌的希露菲葉特，並收其為徒傳授法術。在此世界線中兩人皆未步入婚姻，而是結伴馳騁於各大險境，成為享譽盛名的迷宮探索者。由於兩人都擁有長逾人類的漫長壽命且外型非世俗主流審美，她們在漫長歲月中相互扶持、相伴終老，續寫了奇妙的命運羈絆。

艾莉絲的王國騎士之路與王位之爭

未經歷轉移災難與魔大陸歷練的艾莉絲，憑藉過人天賦習得光之劍，隨後獲徵召加入騎士團，成為愛麗兒公主的貼身侍衛。同僚路克對艾莉絲一見鍾情並展開熱烈追求，歷經無數次被痛擊後兩人最終結為連理且感情和睦。在艾莉絲及其健全的伯雷亞斯家族全力支持下，愛麗兒成功化解多次刺殺陰謀並順利登基為女王，徹底改變了王國的權力版圖。
